Equipment by team

Two teams share a storage room. The coach counts helmets, cones, and practice balls for each team before the season starts. A matrix keeps the counts in the same order for both teams.

Reading the equipment matrix

Each row is one kind of equipment. The first column belongs to the morning team and the second to the evening team.

E=[ 6 30 14 10 24 20 ] [ 24 35 ] ( 79 810 ) 1113 1214

Read across a row to compare the teams. Read down a column to find what one team needs to bring to practice.
